# cloud-cost-analyzer

> Analyze FOCUS 1.0 cloud cost CSV exports with Decimal arithmetic: grouped totals by day or month, period comparison and tag coverage Python package `trysac-cloud-cost-analyzer`, import name `cloud_cost_analyzer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
